Kagome has her sacred jewel shards taken away from her and is returned to the present day, unable to return to feudal Japan.
Kagome returns to the shrine in the middle of her date with Hojo. She senses the presence of the Shikon Jewel shards and returns to feudal Japan.
Kikyo, who was brought back to life, is living as a priestess.
Kikyo paralyzes Kagome. Inuyasha appears before her. Kikyo has been gathering the souls of dead girls.
Inuyasha Movie 4: Fire on the Mystic Island (English Dubbed)
Inuyasha faces the Four War Gods and the past he left behind on Horai Island fifty years ago.
Sango, a demon slayer, is invited to Hitomi Castle along with her father, the leader of the demon slayers, and her younger brother, Kohaku.
Sango fights Inuyasha, believing him to be her enemy. Naraku's plan is to have her fight to the death using the power of the Shikon Jewel shard.
Sango reveals the secret story of the Shikon Jewel's birth.
Inuyasha and the gang meet Taromaru, the son of a village leader. They go to the Temple of the Water God, where children are being sacrificed.
In a certain village, Shippo meets a girl named Satsuki. Satsuki believes that her brother, who went to war, will come back.
Husbands are being lured away from their village by a beautiful demon. Their wives ask Miroku to defeat the demon.
Sango goes back to the slayer village in order to fix her Hiraikotsu, and Kagome goes back to the well so she can return to the present day.
Inuyasha is able to escape from the miniature garden with the help of Miroku and the others, and goes to save Kagome.
Sango returns to the demon slayer village and repairs her Hiraikotsu. She also lays her father and her comrades' ashes to rest.
Naraku calls upon a priestess named Tsubaki. Fifty years ago, Tsubaki was defeated by Kikyo when she went after the Shikon Jewel.
Kagome desperately fights the curse placed on her by Tsubaki, a dark priestess. Meanwhile, Kikyo appears before Tsubaki.
Tsubaki's curse steals Kagome's consciousness. Kagome forgets feudal Japan in an illusory world.
Tsubaki visits the onmyoji mansion where she once trained.
Tsubaki is a priestess who was considered to be on par with Kikyo.
One night, someone possesses Sango to attack Miroku. The group examines the centipede demon that they suspect was behind it, but they are mistaken.
There is a rift in Naraku's barrier. But it's the beginning of the month, and when night falls, Inuyasha loses his demon powers.
